title: Бит Экс Нео
alt: B'T-X NEO　ビート・エックス ネオ
description: Teppei have managed to defeat Machine Empire’s forces time and again, escalating his rescue attempt of his brother into an all out war! His courage has even earned the support of the Empire’s Spiritual Guardians. Together with Teppei, they now seek to learn Machine Empire’s true motives and put an end to their rampant destruction. (Source: TMS)

en:
Teppei have managed to defeat Machine Empire’s forces time and again, escalating his rescue attempt of his brother into an all out war! His courage has even earned the support of the Empire’s Spiritual  Guardians. Together with Teppei, they now seek to learn Machine Empire’s true motives and put an end to their rampant destruction.



(Source: TMS)
